description: A bold and minimalist logo designed for maximum impact. Set against a deep black background, the design features the word “RAW” in solid white, symbolizing power, clarity, and authenticity. Beneath it, “PULSE” appears in a sleek white outline, representing energy, rhythm, and the heartbeat of the wild. The contrast between solid and outline typography creates a modern, dynamic feel—perfectly capturing the essence of raw, unfiltered nature and the pulse of life within it.
